Trigger.name: party vitals gag
Trigger.script: -- Gag the party-channel vitals line and route it to the grid. -- matches[2]=name matches[3]=HP:[..]..EP payload. Buff 'reports' lines -- are NOT matched, so they stay in main. if partyinfo and partyinfo.onVitalsLine then partyinfo.onVitalsLine(matches[2], matches[3]) end deleteLine()

Trigger.name: party reports gag
Trigger.script: -- Gag the party-channel buff 'reports' lines (spell announcements). deleteLine()

Trigger.name: party position
Trigger.script: if partyinfo and partyinfo.onPosition then partyinfo.onPosition(matches[2], matches[3], matches[4]) end

Trigger.name: party position swap
Trigger.script: -- Dual-swap line: "Name moves to R,C and Name moves to R,C" if partyinfo and partyinfo.onPosition then partyinfo.onPosition(matches[2], matches[3], matches[4]) partyinfo.onPosition(matches[5], matches[6], matches[7]) end

Trigger.name: party guided
Trigger.script: if partyinfo and partyinfo.onPosition then partyinfo.onPosition(matches[2], matches[3], matches[4]) end

Trigger.name: party ps row
Trigger.script: if partyinfo and partyinfo.onStatusRow then partyinfo.onStatusRow(matches[2], matches[3], matches[4], matches[5], matches[6], matches[7], matches[8], matches[9]) end

Trigger.name: party ps name
Trigger.script: if partyinfo and partyinfo.onPartyName then partyinfo.onPartyName(matches[2]) end

Trigger.name: party member left
Trigger.script: if partyinfo and partyinfo.onLeft then partyinfo.onLeft(matches[2]) end

Trigger.name: party unform
Trigger.script: if partyinfo and partyinfo.onUnform then partyinfo.onUnform(matches[2]) end

Trigger.name: self leave
Trigger.script: -- YOU are no longer in a party -> hide the whole panel. if partyinfo and partyinfo.onSelfLeave then partyinfo.onSelfLeave() end

Trigger.name: self kicked
Trigger.script: -- YOU are no longer in a party -> hide the whole panel. if partyinfo and partyinfo.onSelfLeave then partyinfo.onSelfLeave() end

regexCodeList.string: ^You have been kicked out from party\.

Trigger.name: party disbanded
Trigger.script: -- YOU are no longer in a party -> hide the whole panel. if partyinfo and partyinfo.onSelfLeave then partyinfo.onSelfLeave() end

Trigger.name: party formed
Trigger.script: -- You created a party — show the panel and set the name. if partyinfo and partyinfo.onPartyName then partyinfo.onPartyName(matches[2]) end

Script.name: partyinfo.core
Script.script: -- Party Info — party formation HUD for Icesus. -- v2.0 • companion to icesus.core + Elemental Bonds. -- -- Gags the party-channel vitals firehose from the main console and renders -- each member as a compact HP / SP / EP block placed in a fixed 3x3 grid -- that mirrors Icesus party formation positions (1,1 .. 3,3). -- -- The panel is ALWAYS shown and never auto-hides — an earlier auto-hide -- made neighbouring windows jump when the panel appeared/disappeared. -- Empty formation cells render as faint placeholders so the layout is -- rock-steady regardless of party size. -- -- Position data comes from two sources, both parsed here: -- 1. Live formation messages (steps/moves/guides to position R,C). -- 2. The `ps` party-status table (authoritative; also carries Fol/Lea -- + the O/C/D column and per-member Hp/Sp/Ep). -- Continuous vitals come from the gagged feed (SP only, no PSP). partyinfo = partyinfo or {} partyinfo.version = "2.3" -- Hot-reload teardown of a previous instance. if type(partyinfo.teardown) == "function" then pcall(partyinfo.teardown) end -- ============================================================= -- Config. -- ============================================================= partyinfo.config = { width = 330, -- panel width (px); `party width N` overrides panelH = 180, -- panel HEIGHT (px). The panel floats as a top-level -- overlay: its top aligns with the banner (y=0) and -- the rest sits OVER the top-right of the main console, -- so the console keeps its full height. `party height N`. cellGap = 3, -- px between grid cells headerH = 16, -- px for the "PARTY name" header strip forgetSecs = 120, -- drop a member after this long with no update AND -- no known position (covers silent disconnects) } -- Grid is 3 rows (positions 1,. 2,. 3,.) x 3 cols (positions .,1 .,2 .,3). partyinfo.ROWS = 3 partyinfo.COLS = 3 -- Reuse icesus palette when present; fall back to literals otherwise. local IP = (type(icesus) == "table" and icesus.palette) or {} partyinfo.palette = { bgMain = IP.bgMain or "#131629", bgPanel = IP.bgPanel or "#1a1e35", bgInput = IP.bgInput or "#0f1225", border = IP.border or "#2a2f4e", borderBright = IP.borderBright or "#3a3f5e", text = IP.text or "#c8cdd8", textDim = IP.textDim or "#8b90a5", textBright = IP.textBright or "#eef0f6", ice = IP.ice or "#7dd3fc", iceBright = IP.iceBright or "#bae6fd", amber = IP.amber or "#fbbf24", hpA = "#8b1a1a", hpB = "#dc2626", -- HP gradient (low → high colour) spA = "#1e3a8a", spB = "#3b82f6", -- SP gradient epA = "#7c5314", epB = "#b45309", -- EP gradient } partyinfo.fontStack = (type(icesus) == "table" and icesus.fontStack) or '"JetBrains Mono", "DejaVu Sans Mono", "Courier New", monospace' -- ============================================================= -- State. -- members[name] = { hp, sp, ep, row, col, role, fronttag, last } -- row/col = formation position (1..3) or nil if unknown. -- role = "Lea" | "Fol" | nil ; fronttag = "O"|"C"|"D"|nil. -- ============================================================= partyinfo.state = partyinfo.state or { members = {}, partyName = "", inParty = false, -- drives panel visibility; set true by any party -- data, cleared by leave/disband/kick events. } partyinfo.hud = nil partyinfo.cells = {} -- cells[r][c] = { bg, nameLbl, hp, sp, ep } partyinfo.aliases = {} partyinfo.timers = {} -- ============================================================= -- Helpers. -- ============================================================= local function htmlEscape(s) return (tostring(s or ""):gsub("[<>&]", { ["<"] = "<", [">"] = ">", ["&"] = "&" })) end -- Vertical glassy gradient (top brighter → bottom darker). local function lgv(top, bot) return string.format( "qlineargradient(x1:0, y1:0, x2:0, y2:1, " .. "stop:0 %s, stop:0.45 %s, stop:1 %s)", top, top, bot) end -- Map a member's row,col to grid indices. Icesus positions are row,col: -- "1,1" = front-left. Front row (row 1) is drawn at the TOP of the grid. local function cellFor(m) if not m or not m.row or not m.col then return nil end local r = tonumber(m.row); local c = tonumber(m.col) if not r or not c or r < 1 or r > partyinfo.ROWS or c < 1 or c > partyinfo.COLS then return nil end return r, c end -- Right-edge offset + width so the panel tucks against the LEFT edge of -- the Elemental Bonds buff bar (between that bar and the icesus banner). local function anchor() local W = tonumber(partyinfo.config.width) or 330 if W < 80 then W = 80 end local ebW = 0 if type(bond) == "table" and bond.ui and bond.ui.WIDTH then ebW = tonumber(bond.ui.WIDTH) or 0 end -- Geyser.Container does not support "-N" right-anchoring string constraints -- (only Label/MiniConsole do). Compute an absolute left-edge pixel instead: -- x = windowWidth - ebW - W -- so the panel's right edge touches the EB bar's left edge. local mw = 1920 pcall(function() if getMainWindowSize then mw = getMainWindowSize() or mw end end) local absX = mw - ebW - W return absX, W end -- Move the already-built panel to the correct absolute x using the LIVE -- window size. Called on every show so a stale build-time measurement never -- causes the panel to appear in the wrong place. function partyinfo.reposition() if not partyinfo.hud or not partyinfo.hud.panel then return end local absX, W = anchor() pcall(function() partyinfo.hud.panel:move(absX, 0) end) end -- Shrink the icesus banner so its right edge meets OUR left edge, clearing -- both this panel and the EB bar. Reversible on teardown. function partyinfo.fitBanner(restore) local banner = icesus and icesus.hud and icesus.hud.banner if not banner then return end if restore then if type(bond) == "table" and bond.ui and bond.ui.fitBanner then pcall(function() bond.ui.fitBanner() end) else pcall(function() banner:resize("100%", nil) end) end return end local W = tonumber(partyinfo.config.width) or 330 local ebW = 0 if type(bond) == "table" and bond.ui and bond.ui.WIDTH then ebW = tonumber(bond.ui.WIDTH) or 0 end pcall(function() banner:resize("100%-" .. (W + ebW + 1), nil) end) end -- Push (or restore) icesus.hud.right so it starts below our panel instead -- of being overlapped by it. We only move it when panelH exceeds the -- existing borderTop (92 px) — EB already owns that strip. -- restore=true returns the right column to its icesus.core defaults. function partyinfo.fitRightColumn(restore) local right = icesus and icesus.hud and icesus.hud.right if not right then return end local T = (icesus and icesus.config and icesus.config.borderTop) or 92 local B = (icesus and icesus.config and icesus.config.borderBottom) or 64 if restore then -- Return right column to its icesus defaults: y=T, height=100%-(T+B) pcall(function() right:move(nil, T) right:resize(nil, "100%-" .. (T + B)) end) return end local PH = tonumber(partyinfo.config.panelH) or 180 if PH <= T then return end -- panel fits inside existing banner strip, nothing to do -- Move the right column down to start below our panel, shrink its height to match. pcall(function() right:move(nil, PH) right:resize(nil, "100%-" .. (PH + B)) end) end -- ============================================================= -- HUD construction — a fixed 3x3 grid of cells, built once. -- ============================================================= function partyinfo.setupHUD() if partyinfo.hud then return end local P = partyinfo.palette local C = partyinfo.config local top = 92 pcall(function() if getBorderTop then top = getBorderTop() end end) if not top or top < 1 then top = 92 end local x, W = anchor() -- Panel height: a fixed overlay that floats DOWN over the console. We -- clamp it to at least the banner height so it never sits above it, and -- the surplus below borderTop overlaps the console's top-right corner. local PH = tonumber(C.panelH) or 180 if PH < top then PH = top end partyinfo.hud = {} -- Top-level overlay (parent omitted): the "-N" x anchor pins it to the -- right side over the console, NOT inside the reserved top border, so the -- console keeps its full height and we float on top of it. partyinfo.hud.panel = Geyser.Container:new({ name = "partyinfo.panel", x = x, y = 0, width = W, height = PH, }) partyinfo.hud.bg = Geyser.Label:new({ name = "partyinfo.bg", x = 0, y = 0, width = "100%", height = "100%", }, partyinfo.hud.panel) partyinfo.hud.bg:setStyleSheet(string.format([[ background: %s; border: 1px solid %s; border-radius: 4px; ]], P.bgMain, P.border)) partyinfo.hud.header = Geyser.Label:new({ name = "partyinfo.header", x = 5, y = 2, width = "100%-10", height = C.headerH, }, partyinfo.hud.panel) partyinfo.hud.header:setStyleSheet(string.format([[ background: transparent; color: %s; font-family: %s; font-size: 9pt; font-weight: 700; qproperty-alignment: 'AlignLeft | AlignVCenter'; ]], P.ice, partyinfo.fontStack)) pcall(function() partyinfo.hud.header:setFontSize(8) end) partyinfo.hud.header:echo("PARTY") -- Cell geometry — driven by the panel's own height (PH), so the cells -- grow as the overlay extends down over the console. local gridTop = C.headerH + 4 local gridH = PH - gridTop - 2 local gap = C.cellGap local innerW = (W - 2) - gap * (partyinfo.COLS + 1) local cellW = math.floor(innerW / partyinfo.COLS) local cellH = math.floor((gridH - gap * (partyinfo.ROWS - 1)) / partyinfo.ROWS) partyinfo.cells = {} for r = 1, partyinfo.ROWS do partyinfo.cells[r] = {} for c = 1, partyinfo.COLS do local cx = gap + (c - 1) * (cellW + gap) local cy = gridTop + (r - 1) * (cellH + gap) partyinfo.cells[r][c] = partyinfo.makeCell(r, c, cx, cy, cellW, cellH) end end partyinfo.fitBanner() partyinfo.redraw() end -- Build one grid cell: backdrop label + name label + three thin gauges. function partyinfo.makeCell(r, c, x, y, w, h) local P = partyinfo.palette local cell = { r = r, c = c, x = x, y = y, w = w, h = h } local tag = r .. "_" .. c cell.bg = Geyser.Label:new({ name = "partyinfo.cellbg." .. tag, x = x, y = y, width = w, height = h, }, partyinfo.hud.panel) local pad = 3 cell.nameLbl = Geyser.Label:new({ name = "partyinfo.cellname." .. tag, x = x + pad, y = y + 2, width = w - pad * 2, height = 12, }, partyinfo.hud.panel) cell.nameLbl:setStyleSheet(string.format([[ background: transparent; color: %s; font-family: %s; font-size: 8pt; font-weight: 600; qproperty-alignment: 'AlignLeft | AlignVCenter'; ]], P.textBright, partyinfo.fontStack)) pcall(function() cell.nameLbl:setFontSize(8) end) local barH = 7 local barY0 = y + 14 local function bar(key, idx, gradA, gradB) local gg = Geyser.Gauge:new({ name = "partyinfo." .. key .. "." .. tag, x = x + pad, y = barY0 + idx * (barH + 1), width = w - pad * 2, height = barH, }, partyinfo.hud.panel) gg.front:setStyleSheet(string.format([[ background: %s; border: 1px solid rgba(0,0,0,0.45); border-radius: 2px; ]], lgv(gradB, gradA))) gg.back:setStyleSheet(string.format([[ background: %s; border: 1px solid %s; border-radius: 2px; ]], P.bgInput, P.border)) gg.text:setStyleSheet(string.format([[ color: %s; font-family: %s; font-size: 7pt; qproperty-alignment: 'AlignCenter'; ]], P.textBright, partyinfo.fontStack)) pcall(function() gg.text:setFontSize(7) end) gg:setValue(0, 1, "") return gg end cell.hp = bar("hp", 0, P.hpA, P.hpB) cell.sp = bar("sp", 1, P.spA, P.spB) cell.ep = bar("ep", 2, P.epA, P.epB) return cell end -- ============================================================= -- Draw — paint every cell from current state. Empty cells become faint -- placeholders; always full 3x3 so nothing shifts. Leader cell gets an -- ice-tinted border + star. -- ============================================================= function partyinfo.redraw() if not partyinfo.hud then return end local P = partyinfo.palette local occupant = {} for name, m in pairs(partyinfo.state.members) do local r, c = cellFor(m) if r then occupant[r .. "," .. c] = name end end local count = 0 for _ in pairs(partyinfo.state.members) do count = count + 1 end local nm = partyinfo.state.partyName partyinfo.hud.header:echo(string.format( [[PARTY]] .. [[%s%s]], P.ice, P.textDim, (nm ~= "" and (" " .. htmlEscape(nm)) or ""), count > 0 and (" · " .. count) or "")) for r = 1, partyinfo.ROWS do for c = 1, partyinfo.COLS do local cell = partyinfo.cells[r][c] local name = occupant[r .. "," .. c] if name then local m = partyinfo.state.members[name] local isLeader = (m.role == "Lea") local bd = isLeader and P.iceBright or P.borderBright cell.bg:setStyleSheet(string.format([[ background: %s; border: 1px solid %s; border-radius: 3px; ]], P.bgPanel, bd)) local star = isLeader and string.format([[ ★]], P.amber) or "" local tag = (m.fronttag and m.fronttag ~= "") and string.format([[ %s]], P.textDim, htmlEscape(m.fronttag)) or "" cell.nameLbl:echo(string.format( [[%s%s%s]], P.textBright, htmlEscape(name), star, tag)) cell.nameLbl:show() local function setG(g, pct, label) local p = math.min(math.max(tonumber(pct) or 0, 0), 100) g:setValue(p, 100, string.format("%s %d%%", label, p)) g:show() end setG(cell.hp, m.hp, "H") setG(cell.sp, m.sp, "S") setG(cell.ep, m.ep, "E") else cell.bg:setStyleSheet(string.format([[ background: rgba(255,255,255,0.015); border: 1px dashed %s; border-radius: 3px; ]], P.border)) cell.nameLbl:echo(string.format( [[%d,%d]], r, c)) cell.hp:setValue(0, 1, ""); cell.hp:hide() cell.sp:setValue(0, 1, ""); cell.sp:hide() cell.ep:setValue(0, 1, ""); cell.ep:hide() end end end end -- ============================================================= -- Party membership → panel visibility. -- enterParty(): any party data proves we're in a party → show panel. -- exitParty(): a leave/disband/kick event → clear state, hide panel. -- The panel widget always exists; we only toggle its visibility, so the -- show/hide is a real state transition (joined/left), not transient data. -- ============================================================= function partyinfo.enterParty() if partyinfo.state.inParty then return end partyinfo.state.inParty = true partyinfo.reposition() -- snap to live window size before showing if partyinfo.hud and partyinfo.hud.panel then partyinfo.hud.panel:show() end partyinfo.fitBanner() -- reclaim banner room for the panel partyinfo.fitRightColumn() -- push right column below our panel end function partyinfo.exitParty() partyinfo.state.inParty = false partyinfo.state.members = {} partyinfo.state.partyName = "" if partyinfo.hud and partyinfo.hud.panel then partyinfo.hud.panel:hide() end partyinfo.fitBanner(true) -- give the banner its full width back partyinfo.fitRightColumn(true) -- restore right column to icesus defaults partyinfo.redraw() end -- ============================================================= -- Ingest: continuous vitals from the gagged feed. -- ============================================================= function partyinfo.onVitalsLine(name, payload) if not name or name == "" then return end partyinfo.enterParty() payload = tostring(payload or "") local hp = payload:match("HP:%[[^%]]*%]%s*(%d+)%%") local sp = payload:match("SP:%[[^%]]*%]%s*(%d+)%%") local ep = payload:match("EP:%[[^%]]*%]%s*(%d+)%%") local m = partyinfo.state.members[name] if not m then m = { hp = 0, sp = 0, ep = 0 } partyinfo.state.members[name] = m end if hp then m.hp = tonumber(hp) end if sp then m.sp = tonumber(sp) end if ep then m.ep = tonumber(ep) end m.last = os.time() partyinfo.redraw() end -- ============================================================= -- Ingest: formation position from a live message. Captured Name is always -- the one being POSITIONED (works for steps/moves/guides forms). -- ============================================================= function partyinfo.onPosition(name, row, col) if not name or name == "" then return end partyinfo.enterParty() local m = partyinfo.state.members[name] if not m then m = { hp = 0, sp = 0, ep = 0 } partyinfo.state.members[name] = m end m.row = tonumber(row) m.col = tonumber(col) m.last = os.time() partyinfo.redraw() end -- ============================================================= -- Ingest: a row of the `ps` table (authoritative position + role + vitals). -- ============================================================= function partyinfo.onStatusRow(name, row, col, role, fronttag, hp, sp, ep) if not name or name == "" then return end partyinfo.enterParty() local m = partyinfo.state.members[name] if not m then m = { hp = 0, sp = 0, ep = 0 } partyinfo.state.members[name] = m end m.row = tonumber(row) m.col = tonumber(col) m.role = role m.fronttag = fronttag if hp then m.hp = tonumber(hp) end if sp then m.sp = tonumber(sp) end if ep then m.ep = tonumber(ep) end m.last = os.time() partyinfo.redraw() end function partyinfo.onPartyName(nm) partyinfo.enterParty() partyinfo.state.partyName = tostring(nm or "") partyinfo.redraw() end -- ============================================================= -- Ingest: leaving / unforming. -- -- onSelfLeave(): YOU left, were kicked, or the party disbanded → the -- whole panel goes away. Wire every "you're no longer in a party" line -- to this (see the trigger group). Currently wired: -- "You leave the party." -- Stubs to add as you find the exact text (Icesus wording may vary): -- - kicked: " kicks you out of the party." / "You have been -- kicked from the party." -- - disbanded: "The party has been disbanded." / " -- disbands the party." -- All of them should just call partyinfo.onSelfLeave() — no args needed. -- -- onLeft(name): ANOTHER member left → remove just them from the grid. -- If that empties the party (only happens if you were somehow the last -- tracked member) the panel stays until an explicit self-leave. -- ============================================================= function partyinfo.onSelfLeave() partyinfo.exitParty() cecho("\n[party] left party — panel hidden.\n") end function partyinfo.onLeft(name) if not name then return end partyinfo.state.members[name] = nil partyinfo.redraw() end function partyinfo.onUnform(name) if not name then return end local m = partyinfo.state.members[name] if m then m.row = nil; m.col = nil; partyinfo.redraw() end end -- Drop members silent (no vitals, no position) for a long time. function partyinfo.pruneStale() local now = os.time() local cutoff = tonumber(partyinfo.config.forgetSecs) or 120 local changed = false for name, m in pairs(partyinfo.state.members) do if (not m.row) and (now - (m.last or 0)) > cutoff then partyinfo.state.members[name] = nil changed = true end end if changed then partyinfo.redraw() end end -- ============================================================= -- Commands. -- ============================================================= function partyinfo.clear() partyinfo.state.members = {} partyinfo.redraw() cecho("\n[party] tracked members cleared.\n") end function partyinfo.setWidth(n) local w = tonumber(n) if not w or w < 80 then cecho("\n[party] Usage: party width (e.g. party width 360)\n") cecho("[party] current width: " .. tostring(partyinfo.config.width) .. "\n") return end partyinfo.config.width = math.floor(w) partyinfo.teardownHUD() partyinfo.setupHUD() cecho("\n[party] panel width set to " .. partyinfo.config.width .. " px.\n") end function partyinfo.setHeight(n) local h = tonumber(n) if not h or h < 60 then cecho("\n[party] Usage: party height (e.g. party height 220)\n") cecho("[party] current height: " .. tostring(partyinfo.config.panelH) .. "\n") return end partyinfo.config.panelH = math.floor(h) partyinfo.teardownHUD() partyinfo.setupHUD() if partyinfo.state and partyinfo.state.inParty then partyinfo.hud.panel:show() partyinfo.fitRightColumn() end cecho("\n[party] panel height set to " .. partyinfo.config.panelH .. " px.\n") end -- ============================================================= -- Teardown. -- ============================================================= function partyinfo.teardownHUD() if not partyinfo.hud then return end for r = 1, partyinfo.ROWS do if partyinfo.cells[r] then for c = 1, partyinfo.COLS do local cell = partyinfo.cells[r][c] if cell then for _, w in pairs(cell) do if type(w) == "table" and type(w.hide) == "function" then pcall(function() w:hide() end) end end end end end end partyinfo.cells = {} for _, w in pairs(partyinfo.hud) do if w and type(w.hide) == "function" then pcall(function() w:hide() end) end end partyinfo.hud = nil partyinfo.fitBanner(true) partyinfo.fitRightColumn(true) end function partyinfo.uninstall() for _, t in pairs(partyinfo.timers) do if t then pcall(killTimer, t) end end partyinfo.timers = {} if partyinfo.aliases then for _, a in pairs(partyinfo.aliases) do pcall(killAlias, a) end partyinfo.aliases = {} end partyinfo.teardownHUD() end partyinfo.teardown = partyinfo.uninstall -- ============================================================= -- Install. Panel is built hidden and only appears once party data proves -- we're in a party (any vitals / ps row / formation msg / party name). -- ============================================================= function partyinfo.install() local wasInParty = partyinfo.state and partyinfo.state.inParty partyinfo.uninstall() partyinfo.setupHUD() -- Default hidden. If we were already in a party before a hot-reload, -- keep showing so editing the script mid-session doesn't blank the panel. if wasInParty then partyinfo.state.inParty = true partyinfo.reposition() -- snap to live window size on hot-reload partyinfo.hud.panel:show() partyinfo.fitRightColumn() -- push right column below panel on hot-reload else partyinfo.state.inParty = false partyinfo.hud.panel:hide() partyinfo.fitBanner(true) -- don't reserve banner room while hidden partyinfo.fitRightColumn(true) -- ensure right column is at icesus defaults end partyinfo.aliases.clear = tempAlias("^party clear$", function() partyinfo.clear() end) partyinfo.aliases.width = tempAlias("^party width (%d+)$", function() partyinfo.setWidth(matches[2]) end) partyinfo.aliases.height = tempAlias("^party height (%d+)$", function() partyinfo.setHeight(matches[2]) end) partyinfo.timers.prune = tempTimer(20, function() partyinfo.pruneStale() end, true) cecho("\nParty Info v" .. partyinfo.version .. " ready. Panel appears when you join a party.\n") end partyinfo.install()
